content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Toledo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional years of experience. Review PMI's full education and hours-worked criteria at pmi.org, then contact Granite PM Academy to verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from your Toledo location on a schedule that fits your work calendar—whether you're in manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, or another sector. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, create your PMI account and submit your PMP credential application with proof of education, project experience, and your 35 contact-hour completion certificate from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's examination fee to proceed to exam scheduling.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, domain reviews, and study guides—to reinforce bootcamp learning. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, speaking at industry events, or serving in leadership roles. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Toledo's project-management job market.
